You can `install popular browser extensions` to convert and export ChatGPT conversations into clean Markdown.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-markdown-obsid/dloobgjjpoohngalnjepgdggjeempdec)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpwEBxCJF19ZJV_mpLBskeAq82Kzqp5_hJH9j7MwaaLpTxzthQsfVjy8Q7vjbSEUheUECkSJ0UTE8b7NcoM1HuJOAH6O_B9pIok32VU3xtVNYB6TSkyrPcZtwgJZXLwc6E7DBipDOlt8uwKqvYDTmd41J12VoBznEfGVLoZjaOfXJIZWkXo0Wfrz9MYW1-tfipUN9tH6MvO3DqlGPRv_zE7SUW5Ka7NPYfg)

### Top ChatGPT to Markdown Extensions

- **ChatGPT to Markdown, Obsidian & Notion** : Available on the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-markdown-obsid/dloobgjjpoohngalnjepgdggjeempdec) . It adds an export panel inside ChatGPT to copy markdown, download `.md` files, or save directly to Obsidian and Notion.
- **ChatGPT to Markdown Pro - Code/LaTeX/Table** : Available on the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-markdown-pro-c/adghjpdmpbcmppeafpodcjpagmegdpci) . It handles complex tables, math equations (LaTeX), and code blocks with one-click export.
- **ChatGPT Export to Markdown (Firefox)** : Available on [Mozilla Add-ons](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1xXwVHJDzbApuoGS2wDY_eYCbFJNgbLN0R8ZKz_oFCLL5vsk7MbD53ztcC-5LO-ME-p80cJZig8ceNnFz8cW0Ko-8yplJRjWjtINCHyNTD6vvJqRu2W0zHf_IWdA9L86bB3eRQN-s9_eX7GpeCznItUpEr2gA09rm4L7G2G33Z8KfjA) . A lightweight, local, and offline extension for Firefox users.
- **Open-Source GitHub Option** : Available via [GitHub](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXMY16SL47SYLfwr-hyNWh2JrQPmYvXtqJhVdZoLWGRz7GaqTQU-IGO7uqZ63fydld2O9TBwJCF7kL7HNE8S2BeRrys9xIB7R3W9CL_FLrHU-57pE5aeTbdDRIl7_ECyaqJ_hY) . A client-side Chrome/Edge extension featuring KaTeX math formula parsing and syntax highlighting preservation.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-markdown-pro-c/adghjpdmpbcmppeafpodcjpagmegdpci)[[2]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-markdown-obsid/dloobgjjpoohngalnjepgdggjeempdec)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1xXwVHJDzbApuoGS2wDY_eYCbFJNgbLN0R8ZKz_oFCLL5vsk7MbD53ztcC-5LO-ME-p80cJZig8ceNnFz8cW0Ko-8yplJRjWjtINCHyNTD6vvJqRu2W0zHf_IWdA9L86bB3eRQN-s9_eX7GpeCznItUpEr2gA09rm4L7G2G33Z8KfjA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXMY16SL47SYLfwr-hyNWh2JrQPmYvXtqJhVdZoLWGRz7GaqTQU-IGO7uqZ63fydld2O9TBwJCF7kL7HNE8S2BeRrys9xIB7R3W9CL_FLrHU-57pE5aeTbdDRIl7_ECyaqJ_hY)

### Alternative Ways to Export Without an Extension

- **Web Converters** : Use tools like [ChatGPT to Markdown](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXmMatUoqdrcPwMaQRd664aoPY6ui4JMUzkahDWf5hPXOkVnRIbVQEWCUWwwJmFKAlUPhksVqkZTr8fFwhKkn1FASZjHVAvYVpLvXZJFIGox2a3ll6EwXZ80WJLrBFQh6uyi_S) to convert shared conversation links into `.md`, `.txt` , or `.json` files without logging in.
- **Official Account Export** : Go to ChatGPT **Settings > Data controls > Export data** to download your full archive from OpenAI, then convert the JSON log manually or via a script.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXqCat3RrMyE9UGZxQeI2AD-wK1s4RX6KgiIwLWX5mVnns-p6uVIJqctuPx_LTEEkYV4KpI07N9poe49cik_3adi9hVjW9ky_RCgvR3yx01Qe_WPYs8UKzqHIumjJAAhh-Ux81)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXmMatUoqdrcPwMaQRd664aoPY6ui4JMUzkahDWf5hPXOkVnRIbVQEWCUWwwJmFKAlUPhksVqkZTr8fFwhKkn1FASZjHVAvYVpLvXZJFIGox2a3ll6EwXZ80WJLrBFQh6uyi_S)
